entities.name: abstract method
entities.definition: An abstract method declares a method signature without supplying a body, leaving the implementation to a concrete subclass. It defines a required behavior in an interface or abstract class and cannot be invoked on its own.

entities.name: absolute value function
entities.definition: The absolute value function maps any real number to its non-negative magnitude regardless of sign. It forms a V-shaped graph with the origin as its vertex and acts piecewise linearly.

entities.definition: An algebraic function is defined by combining input variables using only standard operations like addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, powers, and roots. This specific type of mapping ensures the relationship between inputs and outputs remains polynomial or rational in nature.

entities.name: logarithmic function
entities.definition: A logarithmic function is a mathematical mapping defined for any base greater than zero but not equal to one. It establishes an inverse relationship where the output exponent multiplied by the base yields the input argument value.
